causes.text: Confirmed: new hires skip the barcode verification step, proven root cause of mislabeled orders
Proven: the packing checklist order does not match the pick path, causing skipped steps
Verified as the primary driver: the label printer misalignment produces unreadable barcodes on one in ten labels
Established fact: mixed box sizes from the new supplier lead directly to mis-picks
Definitively the cause: the scan gun's old firmware misreads damaged labels
Root cause confirmed by the team: dim lighting at the pack station causes misreads

effect.text: Weekly order-fulfillment defect rate stuck at 9% against a 2% goal
